title: Wool for the Winter Cloth
offer: Everybody wants warm cloth for the winter, and my looms are hungry. Bring me four crates of wool, and I give you a bolt of red cloth.

steps.say: Clack, clack, goes the loom. Here: the reddest cloth I ever made, for you.

fact: The women of a viking farm wove all the cloth: sails, clothes and blankets.
